source.publisher: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
source.title: Medical device stand-alone software including apps

rights.terms: Official public Crown/MHRA guidance; classification depends on intended purpose and applicable law
rights.permitted_destination: regulatory gap assessment and classification checklist

disposition.rationale: Medical-device applicability cannot be decided without a product owner, marketed intended purpose, users, claims, and deployment context. Current research-only software makes no clinical decision claim.
disposition.contingency: Preserve research-only status and complete only a conditional classification checklist.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Retry when intended purpose/deployment is proposed or MHRA guidance/law changes.
